# FG-REPO-0032

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 404 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unknown_requirement_is_not_found` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: その要件 ID は、この版の仕様にありません。ID と版を確かめてください。
- en: That requirement id is not in the specification at this revision. Check the id and the revision.
- id: ID persyaratan itu tidak ada dalam spesifikasi pada revisi ini. Periksa ID dan revisinya.

## 原因 (cause)

`GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/context/requirement?id=…[&ref=…]` (M3 X5, plan 03 §6) looks the id up in the project's own specification at the revision (forge-checks spec_index, the same index as the spec API): no requirement block defines it there. The id may be defined only in a later or earlier version, in another repository (a `repo:` reference: ask that project), or be a kanflow acceptance criterion (`PBI-<n>/AC-<m>`, read with …/context/work-item). Not a server fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `route`, `project_id`, `requirement` and `commit`. List what the revision defines: gstn spec requirements --project <id> --ref <rev> --search <id>. If the answer of that list carries `incomplete` (FG-REPO-0031), the definition may lie past the index's bounds.

## 対処 (fix)

Use an id the revision defines, or the revision that defines it (gstn spec versions --project <id>).
